Empty

Introduction

Placeholder message for an empty field.

Sample Code

Basic usage

<maui-empty description="description" />

Image type

The Empty component has multiple built-in placeholder images, which can be used in different service scenarios.

<!-- common error -->
<maui-empty image="error" description="description" />
<!-- network error -->
<maui-empty image="network" description="description" />
<!-- search message -->
<maui-empty image="search" description="description" />

Custom image

If you need to customize an image, you can use the image attribute to transfer any image URL.

<maui-empty class="custom-image" image="https://example/custom-empty-image.png" description="description" />

Bottom content

You can insert content below the Empty component through the default slot.

<maui-empty description="description">
  <maui-button round type="danger" class="bottom-button">button</maui-button>
</maui-empty>

<style>
  .bottom-button {
    width: 160px;
    height: 40px;
  }
</style>

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
image Image type. The options are error, network, and search. An image URL is supported. String default
description Description below the image. String -

Slots

Name Description
- Custom bottom content.
image Custom icon.
description Custom description.
